caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic object set against a plain, light brown background. The object consists of a long, thin rod with a hooked end at the top and a rounded base at the bottom. Attached to the lower part of the rod is a small, cylindrical cup with a flat circular flange at its base, which appears to be designed to hold or contain something. There is a bracket-like structure connecting the cup to the rod, adding support. The object and its parts are rendered in tones of rust brown and muted metallic gray, suggesting age and use, while the background remains unadorned and monochromatic, allowing the object to stand out clearly.
title: Candle Pendant
